title: 10 Best Artemisia Abrotanum Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Artemisia abrotanum are teas, tinctures, decoctions, capsules, and oils, each offering unique benefits for health. Teas made from dried leaves are commonly used to support digestion and relieve mild nausea. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb, often used for its antiparasitic properties. Decoctions involve simmering the plant material to extract its active compounds, enhancing its therapeutic effects. Capsules offer a convenient and standardized way to consume the herb, while oils are used topically for their antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties.
